verdict.rationale: Data region and residency choice is a fair question for a SaaS email marketing platform that stores contact data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions choosing a storage region, data residency, or where data is hosted. The API, export and permission features cited are unrelated to where data lives, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
